name: dsh-project-mcp-manager
description: dsh-project-mcp-manager: per-project and global MCP server loading for DSH. Reads <projectRoot>/.dsh/mcp.yml or .dsh/mcp.json (plus the read-only Claude Code project file .mcp.json), mounts project rows per project and user-layer rows (~/.dsh/mcp.yml, ~/.dsh/mcp.json, ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/mcp.json) globally as @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client instances with ${VAR} env expansion at mount time, hot-reloads on file change, scopes tool visibility per session, and ships a dsh-mcp CLI that writes either native yml or DSH JSON.
author: wldxiaobai <944418001@qq.com>

scripts.test: node test/test-model.mjs && node test/test-mcp-file.mjs && node test/test-json-file.mjs && node test/test-json-write.mjs && node test/test-registry.mjs && node test/test-cli.mjs
